mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.user_id AS userId, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS holderName, a.currency AS currency, a.cash_balance AS cashBalance, a.status AS status, a.version AS version, a.closed_at AS closedAt FROM account a JOIN auth.users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.account_id = #{id}
